# faust-orbit-ui 0.4.1 (vendored)

The `dist/*.js` files of [faust-orbit-ui](https://github.com/orlarey/faust-orbit-ui)
0.4.1 (Yann Orlarey, MIT license, `LICENSE`), as published on npm from commit
`9286c07`, unmodified. The web page imports `orbit-ui.js` through `index.js`.

To update: `npm pack faust-orbit-ui@VERSION`, copy `package/dist/*.js` and
`package/LICENSE` here, and change the version above.
